## Travel Cancellation Policy — Q3 2026

### 1. Flight Cancellation

**Free Cancellation Window**
- **Domestic flights:** Full refund if cancelled within 24 hours of booking.
- **International flights:** Full refund if cancelled within 48 hours of booking.

**Cancellation Fees by Cabin Class (after free window)**

| Cabin Class | Route Type | Cancellation Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Basic Economy | Any | **Not cancellable** after free window (unless insured) |
| Economy | Domestic | max($50, 15% of ticket price) |
| Economy | International | max($75, 20% of ticket price) |
| Business | Domestic | 5% of ticket price |
| Business | International | 8% of ticket price |
| First Class | Any | **Free cancellation** (no fee) |

**Travel Insurance Override**
- If the traveler purchased the travel insurance add-on, cancellation is covered **regardless of cabin class** — full refund applies at any time.

**Refund Method**
- Refunds are returned via the original payment method (card → card, points → points, split payment → proportional refund).

**Airline-Initiated Cancellations**
- If the airline cancels the flight, the customer always receives a **full refund with no fees**.

---

### 2. Hotel Cancellation

| Room Type | Timing | Fee / Refund |
|---|---|---|
| Standard Room | 48+ hours before check-in | **Free cancellation** (full refund) |
| Standard Room | 24–48 hours before check-in | 50% of first night charge |
| Standard Room | Less than 24 hours before check-in | Full first night charge |
| Suite | Any time | **Non-refundable** (full charge regardless of timing) |

---

### 3. Car Rental Cancellation

| Timing | Fee |
|---|---|
| 24+ hours before pickup | **Free cancellation** |
| Less than 24 hours before pickup | One day's rental charge |

**Luxury & SUV Surcharge**
- Luxury and SUV class rentals incur an **additional $50 cancellation surcharge** at all times, regardless of when the cancellation is made.

---

*Policy effective as of June 15, 2026. Fees differ by route type (domestic vs. international) — always verify the flight's route classification when applying cancellation terms.*
